page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, it features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU includes 48 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AVX-512 vector and deep learning instructions, including AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The instance is equipped with 188 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB per vCPU, and is paired with a single NVIDIA A10 Ampere graphics processing unit featuring 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The platform does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating external network-attached block volumes for operating system and application storage. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier performance for smaller and mid-sized machine learning inference workloads. On small 135M parameter language models, it delivers 9,700 tokens per second during prompt ingestion and 454.43 tokens per second in text generation. With 7B parameter models, the instance achieves 2,489.49 tokens per second for prompt processing and 90.21 tokens per second during token generation. Conversely, standard compute and memory benchmarks place in the middle 50th percentile, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 13,808 and a PassMark CPU score of 36,547.02.

This hardware balance offers strong cost efficiency for GPU-focused inference and graphics rendering tasks that do not demand multi-GPU clusters. However, workloads requiring large 70B parameter models will be constrained by the 24 GB VRAM limit, and high-IOPS operations depend entirely on remote disk performance. Primary workload fits include deep learning inference serving, video transcoding, cloud graphics rendering, and AI-assisted data analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz and 188 GB of RAM. Accelerated by a single NVIDIA A10 GPU with 24 GB of GDDR6 VRAM, the system is engineered for compute and graphics-intensive operations. It includes AVX-512 VNNI acceleration and 16 Gbps baseline networking, though it lacks integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes. In benchmark tests, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in deep learning inference, processing 2,489.49 prompt tokens per second and 90.21 generation tokens per second on 7B parameter models. General-purpose CPU and memory throughput register in the mid-tier category. This instance is best suited for AI inference deployments, video processing pipelines, computer vision applications, and remote graphics rendering tasks.
